first_reader_said: NEH 3:30: Both records are Hananiah ben Shelemiah, who repaired the wall, with the same father link.

why: Both records identify the same wall repairer, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, in NEH 3:30, with identical father links. B is fuller, retaining the reciprocal family tie and NEH 10:23; that verse supplies no patronymic proving the identification, but nothing in it distinguishes another person.
